meta.title: A PR line assigned to another buyer

steps.note: Enable the required tenant configuration before accessing Purchase Requisitions.
Open the Purchase Requisitions area as the buyer.
Use the Open tab, where PR lines eligible for sourcing are listed.

args.goal: On the Open Purchase Requisitions screen, find a line whose assignee is a different buyer, tick it, click Purchase Items, and record whether the line can be sourced or whether assignment-based enforcement prevents the purchase.

steps.note: Perform and observe the assignment-specific selection and Purchase Items behavior that no dedicated PR step exposes.
Verify the resulting screen has no crash, server error, raw identifiers, or malformed values after the purchase attempt.
